title: 紺碧の渡り鳥と、壊れた秒針のワルツ
author: 蘭 マリア

en.title: The Indigo Migratory Bird and the Waltz of the Broken Second Hand
en.premise: In the court of an empire ruled by a stopped clock, nobles are tossed by fate, weaving tales of love and hatred. A prince from a fallen kingdom carries a "broken pocket watch" that threatens to shake the empire's power structure. A foreign princess, described as a "migratory bird" who has descended from the north, ignites a flame of passion in the cold court. Behind the glittering ball, hidden conspiracies intertwine.

zh.title: 深蓝的候鸟与破碎秒针的华尔兹
zh.premise: 在被停摆的钟表统治的帝国宫廷里，命运翻弄的贵族们描绘着爱与恨的交织。亡国王子携带的"破碎怀表"成为动摇帝国权力结构的关键。来自北方的异国王妃，宛如"候鸟"般降临，点燃了冷酷宫廷中的热情之火。奢华舞会的背后，暗流涌动，阴谋交错。
